Meet people near you.\nPrivate by design.
No server and no tracking. Your account is made from your username, your e-mail and five words.
This is your public name. 3 to 24 letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
Only letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore, and it must start with a letter or digit.
Only used to restore your account on another phone. It is never sent anywhere and nobody sees it. Type it carefully: a typo opens a different account.
This does not look like an e-mail address.
The two e-mail addresses are different.
These five words are the secret of your account. Together with your username and your e-mail they bring your account back on any phone.

Write them down and keep them safe. Anyone who has them, your username and your e-mail can take over your account. There is no reset: if you lose the words, you lose the account. The words cannot be changed later.
You must be 18 or older. Your profile shows your age, the date of birth stays on this phone.
Nearly is only for people aged 18 or older.
An account with this username and e-mail is already on this phone. Please sign in.
On a new phone, check every entry carefully: a wrong entry opens a different, empty account.
